blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Two dengue-related deaths were recorded in Mandaue City this November, prompting the City Health Office to strengthen its prevention and surveillance measures amid an increase in cases this year. Dr. Debra Maria Catulong, Mandaue City health officer, said the two fatalities were from Barangays Umapad and Tabok. Catulong said dengue cases in Mandaue City have increased this year. In 2025, the city recorded 520 cases and three deaths for the entire year, according to a previous report.
